name: FCC
_source: Two frames, cut from FreeFCC's 21 by subset experiments on RC 2 + Lito X1, 2026-08-19. See doc/fcc-minimal-sequence.md. The 21-frame original is kept beside this file as fcc_full.json.
_roles: The two effects have SEPARATE owners, each verified alone: 09:27 (SDR register 0xffff0048=2, setForceFcc) raises transmit power and gives no 5.8; 07:30 (WIFI channel group, ASCII AU twice) gives the 5.8 band. Both are needed for the full switch.
_why_not_fewer: 07:30 alone switches BOTH live but does NOT survive a DJI Fly restart. Adding this one SDR register makes it survive. Region set + commit (06:72), the AUTOTEST service-mode wrapper (10:58), RADIO param (06:8C), the channel map/flag (07:18/07:19), the second SDR register (0xffff0063=3) and every flight-controller parameter write were each tested and dropped — none is needed.
_cadence: EIGHT sends, one second apart (rounds=8, inter_round_delay_ms=1000 — ProfileRunner opens a fresh connection per round). A single send does not take on a live session: measured 2026-08-19, it failed over 20 s of watching, twice, while a one-second burst landed on the 3rd and 4th shot. Two sends 100 ms apart inside one connection did NOT work, so what matters is separate sends spaced in time.
_reverting: The same 07:30 with another two-letter code puts the radio back — RU (this aircraft's own country, ISO 643) returns CE live, no reboot. Codes the firmware takes: AU, CN, US, BO, RU, NL, MY.

frames.note: WIFI channel group AU — the 5.8 band
